leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define TypeScript interfaces to create structured theme objects with consistent property types
Apply React Context to create a theme provider component that supplies theme data to child components
Utilize the useContext hook to access theme values within functional components
Implement styled-components to apply theme-based styling to UI elements
Construct theme-aware components that dynamically adapt their appearance based on theme context
Use TypeScript generics to create reusable theme utilities with type safety
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI variants based on active theme
Modify theme properties to create theme variants (light/dark) with consistent structure
Control theme switching by implementing handlers that update context state
Store theme preferences in localStorage to persist user selections across sessions
Retrieve and apply stored theme preferences during component initialization
Compare theme implementation approaches by applying different styling strategies to the same component
